import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
s=Path('src/BunDomFiberSums.lean').read_text().replace('    rw [Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun f => by simp only [g, Prod.mk.injEq]))]\n    exact rows_card j P Q x y z','''    have e : {f : Fresh j // g f = (x,y,z)} ≃

      Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (fun f => by simp only [g, Prod.mk.injEq])
    exact (Fintype.card_congr e).trans (rows_card j P Q x y z)''').replace('      obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hf','      have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst hf\n      have h2 := congrArg (fun t => t.2.1) hf\n      have h3 := congrArg (fun t => t.2.2) hf').replace('Fintype.sum_bool, ','').replace('Nat.add_assoc, ','').replace(', Nat.add_left_comm','')
subprocess.run(['python3','-I','-B','write_lane.py','src/BunDomFiberSums.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
